dedupe_keys.name: multi agent based dynamic optical subcarrier allocation for near real time p2mp operation

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. A multi-agent system manages digital subcarrier allocation among point-to-multipoint optical connections. The source compares its performance with a centralised allocation approach and reports similar performance with increased scalability for near-real-time operation. Coverage is the described algorithm evaluation; agent count, topology and timing results are unspecified. This record captures the implemented allocation model without presenting the short abstract as proof of a deployed autonomous carrier network. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The multi-agent model supports optimisation of subcarrier allocation for point-to-multipoint connections.
